a: An API gateway is a single entry point for routing, auth, rate limits, and observability.
A reverse proxy sits in front of servers to load-balance and terminate TLS.
Cloudflare provides CDN, DNS, WAF, and edge compute services.
A Web Application Firewall blocks common web attacks at the edge.
Edge compute runs code near users for lower latency.
Workers run JavaScript/WASM at the edge on Cloudflare's network.
Nginx commonly terminates TLS and proxies to app servers.
Common methods: round-robin, least connections, IP hash.
Sticky sessions route a user to the same backend; prefer stateless design.
TLS termination decrypts HTTPS at the proxy before forwarding HTTP internally.
